Welcome to Sentinel

Sentinel is your deposit only bitcoin wallet. Sentinel cannot send bitcoin. Scan any XPUB and Sentinel will keep watch, alerting you of any new incoming transactions and allowing you to create new addresses so you can receive bitcoin on your mobile device.

Sentinel is the easiest and most secure way to keep track and receive payments to your cold storage wallet.

Sentinel can't send bitcoin out of your wallet, and your private keys are never communicated with Sentinel in any way.

Connecting to your own Dojo full node offers the best level of privacy and independence when interfacing with the Bitcoin network.

IT IS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED TO RUN YOUR OWN DOJO! It is easy to do within Start9/Umbrel or on your own hardware. This is a list of a federation of community members who run Dojo\'s for others to use in order to use Sentinel tools. Connecting to a Dojo that is not your own shares your transaction history and addresses with the owner of the Dojo. You are trusting this node with your privacy.
